body: Closes the real gap found earlier today: p.flow was read from IDUNA on connect but never written back, because IDUNA had no way to credit gold at all -- only deduct. Added idunaclient.CreditGold (IDUNA's new PATCH .../gold/credit, commit 1b7f43d) with 3 new tests -- this package's first test file at all. Wired into apps2/mud's connect/disconnect flow: startingFlow captures the real balance after the existing fetch-or-create call, disconnect computes the session's net Flow delta and calls CreditGold/DeductGold accordingly, same best-effort convention the adjacent level/XP/position sync already uses. go build/test clean. Commit 3b75d33.
title: apps2/mud's Flow now syncs back to IDUNA on disconnect
